cohort: The study included 247 maternities with complete uterine rupture after the start of labor in Norway between 1967 and 2008.
finding: Unscarred uteri, maternal age >=35 years, parity >=3, and rupture detection after vaginal delivery showed the highest associations with the risk of peripartum hysterectomy after complete uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Rupture detection after vaginal delivery significantly increased the risk of peripartum hysterectomy following complete uterine rupture.
